API

<ray-tabs>

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevaluestringValue of the active tab (default: the first enabled one).
variantvariant reflectsdefault | outline | pillsdefaultTab style.
orientationorientation reflectshorizontal | verticalhorizontalTab list direction (and arrow keys).
colorcolor reflectsstringActive indicator color.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlsmHeight, font size and padding of the tabs (xs for a compact bar).
activationactivationauto | manualautomanual: arrows move focus, Enter/Space activates.
growgrow reflectsbooleanTabs share the full width.
EventDescription
changeThe user activated another tab.
SlotDescription
(default)ray-tab and ray-tab-panel elements (tabs move to the tab list on their own).
PartDescription
listThe tab list.
panelsThe panel area.

leftIcon.
